prior_importants.description: Moving the backlog's scope into a `title` attribute takes it out of the text the `data-list` filter searches, so filtering the backlog by a path or glob now matches nothing.

Adding `inline` to the backlog list lets `ul.rows.inline > li { display: flex }` (0,2,2) override `[data-list] li[hidden] { display: none }` (0,2,1), so the page's filter and pager never hide a backlog row
The Decisions filter no longer finds a record by its date: the day moved out of each row into the group's <h3>, and the page script searches only the row text.

process_issues.description: Security, simplicity and guards were not spawned. The delta is +9/-4: a CSS selector, a time-string format and two test assertions. It crosses no trust boundary, adds no file, helper or branch, and changes no source a guard test scans. The consolidator and validators were not spawned because the reviewers returned no findings.
